Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://www.icmr.nic.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) for filling up administrative positions on a deputation basis at its headquarters in New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post notified under this recruitment?
faq.answer: The notified post is Assistant Director General (Admin) under the Indian Council of Medical Research, responsible for overseeing crucial administrative and financial operations.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for this position?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Assistant Director General (Admin) in the current recruitment cycle issued by the Indian Council of Medical Research.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ICMR ADG Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. Candidates must fill out the prescribed application form and submit it through the proper channel via postal services.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the post?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess any degree along with a working knowledge of computers, alongside holding analogous posts or required administrative experience as specified in the official circular.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the post of Assistant Director General (Admin) on deputation is not exceeding 56 years as on the last date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Director General (Admin) position will be compensated under Pay Level-12, with a salary ranging from Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700 per month.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the completed offline application be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be forwarded through the proper channel to The Administrative Officer (Recruitment & Promotion Cell), Indian Council of Medical Research, V. Ramalingaswamy Bhawan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi-110029.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting eligible candidates based on qualifications and experience, followed by an interview session which may be conducted either offline or online at ICMR Headquarters.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application?
faq.answer: Applicants must attach educational certificates, experience certificates, cadre clearance, APARs for preceding five years, vigilance clearance, integrity certificate, and NOC through proper channel.
